---
title: Heading anchor targets
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          # sectionize moves the id to the <section>; the heading names it
          # in `data-anchor-id` so AnchorJS links to `#overview`, not an
          # invented `#overview-1` (bd-d5gss9pz; Q1
          # format-html-bootstrap.ts:534-544).
          - 'section#overview > h2.anchored[data-anchor-id="overview"]'
          - 'section#custom-id > h3.anchored[data-anchor-id="custom-id"]'
          # `.no-anchor` opts out of the link, not the attribute (as Q1).
          - 'section#quiet > h2.no-anchor[data-anchor-id="quiet"]'
        -
          - 'h2.anchored:not([data-anchor-id])'
          - 'h2[id]'
---

## Overview

Intro text.

### Details {#custom-id}

More text.

## Quiet {.no-anchor}

No hover link here.
